subject: Medford Lions Club Community Initiatives
overview: Sharon Deyeso of the Medford Lions Club discussed the organization's history of medical research and current local charitable efforts. The presentation highlighted upcoming fundraising events, eyeglass recycling programs, and the selection of the annual scholarship recipient.

items.title: Guest introduction and background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced Sharon Deyeso, who discussed her experience as a long-time Medford resident and former educator at the high school.

items.title: Lions International mission and history
items.summary: Deyeso outlined the 1917 founding of the Lions and their global focus on eyesight, hearing, diabetes, and disaster relief.

items.title: Local chapter fundraising and programs
items.summary: Medford Lions initiatives include a November turkey raffle, foster care support, and maintaining eyeglass collection boxes at City Hall and local banks.

items.title: Medical research advocacy
items.summary: The speaker highlighted the organization's historical role in funding research for infant blindness and supporting retinal chip technology.

items.title: Membership and youth outreach
items.summary: The club provided contact information for new members and discussed plans to establish a Leo club for local youth aged 13 to 18.

items.title: Vision screenings and mobile health
items.summary: The discussion covered the history of vision screenings in Medford schools and the availability of the iMobile testing van for community events.

items.title: Annual scholarship announcement
items.summary: The club announced Rebecca Oliveira as the 2026 scholarship recipient and invited the public to the June 15 award ceremony at the Medford VFW.
